name: marketing-council
description: Marketing strategy plugin with 29 focused skills, a conservative dynamic skill router, specialist agents, evidence gates, and deterministic marketing decision workflows.

interface.longDescription: Marketing Council routes marketing briefs across 29 focused skills, then applies specialist agents, evidence checks, commercial constraints, current-state research, and causal measurement discipline. Narrow requests go directly to the owning skill; ambiguous or cross-functional requests fall back to the council for explicit arbitration.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this marketing problem and route it to the right specialist skill.
Run a council debate on this strategy and make one defensible commercial decision.
Red-team this marketing plan, then rebuild the parts that would fail commercially.
